version.changelog: Complete rewrite using native AppleScript instead of memo CLI. Subfolder paths, CRUD, smart folder name handling (Finance / Tax), ID-based lookups, search with title+body fallback.

llm.summary: The skill appears to implement the advertised Apple Notes actions via local AppleScript shell scripts (coherent), but it lets the AI model invoke those scripts (including read/edit/delete) without requiring explicit user invocation and omits some expected declarations — you should review the scripts and invocation settings before installing.

dimensions.detail: Name/description align with the actual scripts: list, read, create, search, edit, delete via AppleScript. One minor inconsistency: required binaries are declared as none even though these scripts will almost certainly call macOS's osascript (not listed). Otherwise the requested capabilities (access to Notes.app and all notes/folders) match the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md is explicit and scoped to Notes.app operations; it does not instruct reading unrelated system files or contacting external endpoints. It does indicate use of temp files and full-folder iteration (can access all 4k+ notes), and allows edits/deletes. Those behaviors are expected for a Notes integration but are high-impact (reads and destructive writes) and worth reviewing.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec (instruction-only with bundled shell scripts). This minimizes installer risk, but the presence of executable scripts means code will run locally — inspect the scripts before use. No remote downloads/extracts are present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no environment variables or credentials, which is appropriate. It will access the user's Notes data (inherent to its purpose) but does not demand unrelated secrets or tokens.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Model invocation is allowed (disable-model-invocation not set). That means an agent could autonomously run these scripts and read/modify/delete notes. Although always:true is not set, having model-invocable access to a personal notes DB is a meaningful privacy/privilege risk and should be explicitly controlled (e.g., require explicit user invocation or disable autonomous invocation).
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Before installing: 1) Review the shell scripts (scripts/*.sh) to confirm they use osascript and only perform the promised Notes operations; look for any unexpected network calls, file reads/writes outside temp files, or exec of untrusted code. 2) Test on a non-sensitive note/folder first and back up Notes.app data. 3) Because the scripts create temp files, verify they don't leave sensitive text on disk and that temporary paths are safe. 4) Consider changing the skill settings to require explicit user invocation or set disable-model-invocation:true so the AI cannot autonomously read/modify/delete your notes. 5) Confirm the 'folder required' safety behavior for delete actually prevents accidental cross-folder deletion (try a dry-run or listing before delete). If you are not comfortable reviewing the scripts, do not install or only enable the skill in a restricted, manual mode.
